verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Abraham, styled “the friend,” was found faithful, inasmuch as he rendered obedience to the words of God.
verses.modernizedText: Abraham, styled “the friend,” was found faithful, inasmuch as he rendered obedience to the words of God.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: He, in the exercise of obedience, went out from his own country, and from his kindred, and from his father’s house, in order that, by forsaking a small territory, and a weak family, and an insignificant house, he might inherit the promises of God.
verses.modernizedText: He, in the exercise of obedience, went out from his own country, and from his kindred, and from his father’s house, in order that, by forsaking a small territory, and a weak family, and an insignificant house, he might inherit the promises of God.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For God said to him, “Get thee out from thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, into the land which I shall show thee.
verses.modernizedText: For God said to him, “Get you out from your country, and from your kindred, and from your father’s house, into the land which I shall show you.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And I will make thee a great nation, and will bless thee, and make thy name great, and thou shalt be blessed.
verses.modernizedText: And I will make you a great nation, and will bless you, and make your name great, and you shall be blessed.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse them that curse thee; and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.”
verses.modernizedText: And I will bless them that bless you, and curse them that curse you; and in you shall all the families of the earth be blessed.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And again, on his departing from Lot, God said to him, “Lift up thine eyes, and look from the place where thou now art, northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward; for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.modernizedText: And again, upon his departure from Lot, God said to him, “Lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you now are, northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward; for all the land which you see, to you will I give it, and to your seed forever.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth, [so that] if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.”
verses.modernizedText: And I will make your seed as the dust of the earth, [so that] if a man can number the dust of the earth, then your seed shall also be numbered.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And again [the Scripture] saith, “God brought forth Abram, and spake unto him, Look up now to heaven, and count the stars if thou be able to number them; so shall thy seed be.
verses.modernizedText: And again [the Scripture] says, “God brought forth Abram, and spoke to him, Look up now to heaven, and count the stars if you are able to number them; so shall your seed be.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And Abram believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
verses.modernizedText: And Abram believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: On account of his faith and hospitality, a son was given him in his old age; and in the exercise of obedience, he offered him as a sacrifice to God on one of the mountains which He showed him.
verses.modernizedText: On account of his faith and hospitality, a son was given to him in his old age; and in the exercise of obedience, he offered him as a sacrifice to God on one of the mountains which He showed him.
